provenance.source: Aurora City simulated network telemetry v1
provenance.notes: Every sample is generated by a seeded simulator and every event below is authored. Nothing is observed traffic and nothing describes a real organisation.

events.title: Reconnaissance sweep against the north grid gateway
events.description: Many new external peers and a jump in connection attempts, as a port scan would produce.

events.title: Credential guessing against the hospital VPN gateway
events.description: Sustained failed logins, partly outside working hours, on an internet-exposed gateway.

events.title: Large off-hours outbound transfer from a water operator workstation
events.description: One day of unusually high outbound volume, mostly outside working hours.

events.title: Unusual write commands to a substation PLC
events.description: More OT write commands than the PLC normally receives, from peers it does not usually talk to.

events.title: Scheduled maintenance and bulk transfer (benign)
events.description: A planned overnight software update. It looks anomalous to a statistical detector but is not an attack.
